name: CAPSTONE 4 - Vendor Comparison and Human Approval (DEMO ONLY)

parameters.formDescription: Upload the supplier quotations (PDF or image) for 20 wired 2D USB barcode scanners.

parameters.text:
You are a procurement extraction assistant for Nova Retail Distribution Pvt. Ltd.
Each attached document is one supplier quotation for wired handheld 2D USB barcode scanners.
Extract every quotation into the JSON structure below. Assign vendorId in attachment order: "Vendor A", "Vendor B", "Vendor C", and so on.
Rules:
- Numbers must be plain numbers (no currency symbols or commas). unitPrice and freight are in INR, excluding GST.
- gstRate is a decimal (18% = 0.18). If GST is not stated, use 0.18.
- freight is 0 if delivery is free or included.
- deliveryDays is the number of days to deliver; warrantyMonths is in months.
- validUntil is an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).
- supportOutOfTen: priority/remote installation support = 9, phone and email support = 8, email-only/standard support = 6, otherwise your best estimate from 0 to 10.
- specification: short text such as "2D USB" exactly as confirmed by the quote.
Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown, in this exact structure:
{"quotes":[{"quoteId":"","vendorId":"Vendor A","vendor":"","quantity":0,"unitPrice":0,"freight":0,"gstRate":0.18,"warrantyMonths":0,"deliveryDays":0,"supportOutOfTen":0,"specification":"","validUntil":"","paymentTerms":"","supportNotes":""}],"aiExecutiveSummary":"Two-sentence comparison of cost, warranty, delivery and payment terms."}
